title: Dedalus I wonder its like those names in Gibraltar Delapaz Delagracia they had the devils queer names there
html_source: It’s interesting for Molly to call these the devil’s queer names since Gibraltar is in reference to the Spanish translation of the Arabic Jabal Ṭāriq, or Tariq ibn Ziyad, who led an army across the Gibraltar Strait . Delapaz was a Spanish religious suffix adopted by Jewish converts to Christianity, and paz which means “peace.” Gracia is spanish for “grace” or “mercy,” usually with Christian connotations. Calling these devilish names could be ironic, also fitting in with how Stephen rejects the Church. Dedalus also meaning “craftsman” could connect to Mary’s husband Joseph in the Bible who was a carpenter, perhaps making the devilish connection more contradictory.
